CALL db.index.fulltext.queryNodes("names", $name) YIELD node, score
WITH node, score LIMIT 20
CALL (node) {
  MATCH p=(node)-[:OWNS*]->()
  RETURN COALESCE(MAX(LENGTH(p)), 0) as depth_down
}

CALL (node) {
  MATCH p=(node)<-[:OWNS*]-()
  RETURN COALESCE(MAX(LENGTH(p)), 0) as depth_up
}
WITH node, score, MAX(apoc.coll.max([depth_down, depth_up])) as max_depth
WITH node,
    CASE
      WHEN node:Individual THEN trim(coalesce(node.forename,'') + ' ' + coalesce(node.surname,''))
      WHEN node:LegalEntity THEN node.name
      ELSE coalesce(node.name,'')
    END as name,
  CASE
      WHEN node:Individual THEN coalesce(node.person_id,'')
      WHEN node:LegalEntity THEN node.name
      ELSE coalesce(node.company_number, '')
    END as id,
 score, max_depth
RETURN name, id, labels(node) as labels, score, max_depth ORDER BY  max_depth*score DESC

MATCH p=(c:Company{company_number: $company_company_number})-[:OWNS]->{1,}(:Company|LegalEntity|Individual)
RETURN size(relationships(p)) as level, nodes(p)[0].company_number as start_number, nodes(p)[0].name as start_name, reduce(percentage = 1.0, r IN relationships(p) | percentage * (toFloat(r.ownership_pct_min)/100))*100 as minimum_ownership_percentage, reduce(percentage = 1.0, r IN relationships(p) | percentage * (toFloat(r.ownership_pct_max)/100))*100 as maximum_ownership_percentage, nodes(p)[-1].company_number as end_number, nodes(p)[-1].name as end_name, [n in nodes(p) | n.name] as company_path
